mechanisms: Keep the energy store off zero: it stood empty from 8:17 to 11:15 (178 s; floor's e0% 29.7 for the game) and the two costliest killed turret frames, armrl_5197 and armllt_17783, built at about two thirds of full speed; at full rate they would have stood about 2 s and 1 s before their killers arrived (the player was told 'STALLING' at 9:58 and 10:14): up to 116 metal, if the finished turrets had then survived, which the record cannot show.

A builder under fire whose gate change reads 0.7 or more while every move is under the world bar stays on its frame: armllt_26740's builder (change 0.69-0.78 from 14:57, hit from 15:01) died with its frame under a 2.6k army, and armllt_17783's builder stood by while one Stout shot its frame down; walking it off would have kept constructor_3766 (135 metal), not the frames (66 and 60).

A refused or no_site extractor step that stays standing: constructor_3766's home extractor at spot_6 (never-started 10:59 and 13:14) stood 2:14 as 'walking to build' after the engine's no_site, and spot_6 held no extractor from 10:07 to the end; no frame metal is involved and the income lost is not measured here. Smaller: list steps that start a frame beside raiders (armllt_20492, armmex_1994: 8 metal), and two of the player's lists naming one spot (5 orders refused, each skipping the turret step after it, 0 metal).
